headline: 6 contracts catalogued across RSK (1 on-chain confirmed), Ethereum Token Bridge addresses not fetched; Union Bridge contracts discovered but without deployed addresses; RSK chain not supported by defipunkd read API.

findings.text: D1: Rootstock Explorer confirms Bridge precompiled contract at 0x0000000000000000000000000000000001000006 with ~20.998M RBTC balance and contract name 'bridge'. Ethereum block explorer search for RSK Token Bridge addresses was not performed (no Ethereum Token Bridge address surfaced from fetched pages). RSK chainId=30 is not indexed by defipunkd API.

D2: Official docs at dev.rootstock.io confirmed. Dev portal documents the Bridge contract address 0x0000000000000000000000000000000001000006 in the BTC-rBTC conversion guide. A dedicated deployed-contracts index page was not located; the tokenbridge addresses URL redirected to Atlas Bridge docs. deployed_contracts_doc set to the conversion guide URL.
D3: No audit links were provided in protocol.audit_links and no audit reports were surfaced from fetched pages. unknowns entry added.

D4: GitHub org https://github.com/rsksmart confirmed from rootstock.io footer. Key repos identified: rsk-precompiled-abis (ABI + address for Bridge precompile), powpeg-node (Powpeg signatory node), rskj (full node), union-bridge-contracts (BitVMX Union Bridge Solidity contracts). No pinned commit SHA could be obtained from the repo index pages; bridge.js file was not directly fetchable (allowlist restriction). Union Bridge contract addresses (PeginManager, PegoutManager, RbtcBridge, AccessManager, CommitteeRegistry) not surfaced from fetchable pages.

D5: Ethereum chain: RSK Token Bridge deploys Bridge and Federation contracts on Ethereum mainnet per dev.rootstock.io documentation, but the specific Ethereum addresses were not surfaced from successfully fetched pages (tokenbridge docs URL redirected). Bitcoin chain: The PowPeg federation address is a Bitcoin P2SH multisig managed by the Bridge contract (query getFederationAddress() on 0x0000000000000000000000000000000001000006); specific Bitcoin address is dynamic and not a fixed deployed contract. RSK chain: Bridge precompile at 0x0000000000000000000000000000000001000006 confirmed on-chain.

D6: No factory contracts were identified in this run. The Union Bridge system includes a CommitteeRegistry that may act as a registry/factory for committees, but no deployed addresses or child enumeration was possible without the Ethereum/RSK contract addresses. RSK chainId=30 is not supported by defipunkd read API.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: Bridge precompile = 'vault' (holds ~21M rBTC); PowPeg federation = 'multisig' (Bitcoin P2SH multisig of pegnatories); Union Bridge AccessManager = 'admin' (role-based access control); Union Bridge RbtcBridge = 'other' (RBTC mint/burn intermediary per RSKIP-502).

D8: All admin_addresses entries trace to fetched URLs. Union Bridge contract addresses (PeginManager, PegoutManager, RbtcBridge, AccessManager, CommitteeRegistry) surfaced only as snippet mentions from GitHub search result for rsksmart/union-bridge-contracts — no deployed addresses extracted from fetched body. Recorded in unknowns[] only.

rationale.verdict: Walked rootstock.io website, dev.rootstock.io docs, GitHub org rsksmart (repo index pages), Rootstock Explorer on-chain, and RSKIPs. Confirmed 1 on-chain RSK contract address (Bridge precompile). Ethereum Token Bridge addresses and Union Bridge deployed addresses not successfully fetched. RSK chainId=30 unsupported by defipunkd API, so no read-API calls were possible. Total: 1 confirmed RSK address + 1 dynamic Bitcoin P2SH federation address (queryable via Bridge) + multiple Union Bridge contract roles without addresses.

evidence.shows: Rootstock official website confirming GitHub org at https://github.com/rsksmart/, docs at https://dev.rootstock.io/, and that PowPeg bridge is the native bridge. Website fetch succeeded.
Rootstock Explorer on-chain confirmation: contract named 'bridge' at 0x0000000000000000000000000000000001000006, balance ~20,998,582 RBTC as of block 9050216.

Developer docs confirming Bridge contract address 0x0000000000000000000000000000000001000006 on RSK mainnet and testnet, and instructions to call getFederationAddress() to get the current Powpeg Bitcoin P2SH address.
RSKIP-122 confirms the Bridge precompiled contract is accessible at address 0x0000000000000000000000000000000001000006.

Official rsksmart GitHub repo providing ABIs and addresses for Rootstock precompiled contracts including the Bridge. Repo is the canonical source for bridge.address and bridge.abi used in all SDK integrations.

Search result confirms rsksmart/union-bridge-contracts repo exists with Union Bridge Solidity contracts (PeginManager, PegoutManager, RbtcBridge, AccessManager, CommitteeRegistry, SignatureManager), all interacting with Bridge precompile at 0x0000000000000000000000000000000001000006 via RSKIP-502.
Search result confirms rsksmart/powpeg-node repo: specialized RSKj node run by PowPeg signatories to interact with the Bridge contract and broadcast peg-out transactions to Bitcoin.

Atlas Bridge documentation page: Atlas is the web interface for the RSK Swap API aggregating multiple bridge providers (Flyover, Boltz, Changelly, Native PowPeg). References rsksmart/bridge releases and rsksmart/rsk-swap-sdk. Docs site confirmed at dev.rootstock.io.

RSKIP-176 describes Programmable Peg-in Addresses and Liquidity Bridge Contract (LBC) architecture. The Powpeg Redeem Script contains both the Powpeg multisig and emergency multisig spending paths, confirming the federation is a Bitcoin P2SH multisig.
Search snippet confirming Bridge Contract address 0x0000000000000000000000000000000001000006 for peg-out transactions on RSK mainnet.

unknowns: D3: No audit reports found — protocol.audit_links was empty and no audit PDFs were surfaced from fetched pages (dev.rootstock.io docs, rootstock.io website, GitHub repos). Audit existence unknown.

D5: Ethereum chain — RSK Token Bridge Ethereum mainnet contract addresses (Bridge.sol, Federation.sol, AllowTokens.sol, MultiSigWallet.sol) were not successfully fetched; dev.rootstock.io/tools/tokenbridge/ redirected to Atlas Bridge docs rather than the token bridge addresses page.

D5: Bitcoin chain — Current PowPeg federation P2SH address is dynamic (returned by getFederationAddress() on Bridge precompile); could not be read as defipunkd API does not support RSK chainId=30. No static Bitcoin address to record.

D6: Union Bridge deployed contract addresses on RSK/Ethereum (PeginManager, PegoutManager, RbtcBridge, AccessManager, CommitteeRegistry, ChallengeManager, StreamManager) not surfaced from fetchable pages.
D4: Pinned commit SHA for rsksmart/rsk-precompiled-abis and rsksmart/union-bridge-contracts could not be obtained — GitHub repo index pages did not render commit SHAs in the fetched content.

D1-offchain: RSK chainId=30 is not supported by defipunkd read API (supported IDs: 1,10,56,130,137,324,8453,42161,43114,59144,81457,534352,11155111). On-chain reads via /api/contract/read and /api/safe/owners were not possible for any RSK addresses.

protocol_metadata.about: RSK Bridge (PowPeg) is the canonical two-way peg mechanism between Bitcoin and Rootstock (RSK), a Bitcoin sidechain with EVM compatibility. Users peg in by sending BTC to the current PowPeg federation Bitcoin P2SH address (queried via getFederationAddress() on the Bridge precompile), receiving an equivalent amount of rBTC on RSK after 100 Bitcoin confirmations (~17 hours). To peg out, users send rBTC to the Bridge contract at 0x0000000000000000000000000000000001000006 on RSK, which releases BTC to the specified Bitcoin address after 4000 RSK block confirmations. The PowPeg federation is a hardware-attested multisig (PowHSM signatories) whose composition can change via governance; a separate Union Bridge (BitVMX-based) is under development for faster peg operations.
